exercises.title: Towers of Hanoi: the moves, and how many there are
exercises.problemHtml:
Move n disks from peg A to peg C using B, never putting a larger disk on a smaller one. Complete:

  • static void moves(int n, char from, char to, char via, StringBuilder out) — append one line "disk d: X -> Y" per move, in the order they happen;
  • static long count(int n) — the number of moves, from the recurrence M(n) = 2·M(n−1) + 1, M(0) = 0, without generating the moves (the grader asks for n = 62).

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 2 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • moves is recursive: n − 1 disks to the spare peg, the largest disk, n − 1 disks back on top.
  • count(62) must answer instantly.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Chuyển n đĩa từ cọc A sang cọc C qua B, không bao giờ đặt đĩa lớn lên đĩa nhỏ. Hoàn thiện moves(n, from, to, via, out) — nối một dòng "disk d: X -> Y" cho mỗi bước, đúng thứ tự xảy ra; và count(n) — số bước, theo hệ thức M(n) = 2·M(n−1) + 1, M(0) = 0, không sinh ra các bước (máy chấm hỏi n = 62).

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: M(n) = 2M(n−1) + 1 gives M(n) = 2ⁿ − 1: the number of MOVES is exponential, so printing them is Θ(2ⁿ) whatever you do. Counting them only needs the recurrence: n calls, O(n).

exercises.title: Fibonacci: from exponential to linear with memoization
exercises.problemHtml:
The starter Fib.fib(int n) is the textbook double recursion — correct, but it recomputes the same values again and again: fib(45) already needs over a billion calls. Keep it recursive but add a memo (long[] or a map) so every fib(k) is computed once. F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1; the grader asks up to n = 90 (still fits in a long).

⏱ Complexity check. One case runs your code on a large input (n = 90) inside a 2-second limit. An O(n) solution finishes in a fraction of a second on any ordinary laptop; an O(φⁿ) (double recursion without a memo) one needs far longer and the case prints TOO SLOW. Without a memo, fib(90) needs about 10¹⁹ calls. The limit is generous on purpose — if it fails, the algorithm is the problem, not your machine.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 2 case(s) (0 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Still recursive (rule R1 needs a recursive call).
  • Each fib(k) computed once.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Hàm khởi đầu Fib.fib(int n) là đệ quy kép của giáo trình — đúng nhưng tính đi tính lại cùng một giá trị: fib(45) đã cần hơn một tỉ lời gọi. Giữ nguyên đệ quy nhưng thêm bảng nhớ (long[] hoặc map) để mỗi fib(k) chỉ tính một lần. F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1; máy chấm hỏi tới n = 90 (vẫn vừa long).

⏱ Kiểm độ phức tạp. Một ca chạy code của bạn với input LỚN (n = 90) trong hạn 2 giây. Lời giải O(n) xong trong chưa tới một giây trên laptop bình thường; bản O(φⁿ) (double recursion without a memo) cần lâu hơn rất nhiều và ca in TOO SLOW. Không có bảng nhớ, fib(90) cần khoảng 10¹⁹ lời gọi. Hạn đặt rộng có chủ ý — trượt ca này thì do thuật toán, không phải do máy bạn.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Without a memo the call tree of fib(n) has about φⁿ nodes (φ ≈ 1.618) because fib(n−2) is computed inside both branches. With a memo every fib(k) is computed once and later calls are O(1) look-ups: n distinct calls, O(n). This is top-down dynamic programming.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Không có bảng nhớ, cây lời gọi của fib(n) có khoảng φⁿ nút (φ ≈ 1,618) vì fib(n−2) được tính trong cả hai nhánh. Có bảng nhớ thì mỗi fib(k) tính một lần, các lần sau là tra O(1): n lời gọi khác nhau, O(n). Đây là quy hoạch động từ trên xuống.

mistakesJson.loi: An int memo — F(47) already overflows an int.|||Bảng nhớ kiểu int — F(47) đã tràn int.
Creating the memo inside fib — every call starts with an empty table and nothing is remembered.|||Tạo bảng nhớ bên trong fib — mỗi lời gọi bắt đầu với bảng rỗng và chẳng nhớ được gì.

exercises.title: Fast power: aⁿ mod m with O(log n) multiplications
exercises.problemHtml:
Complete static long power(long a, long n, long m): aⁿ mod m for 0 ≤ a, n ≤ 10¹⁸ and 1 ≤ m ≤ 10⁹ (so every product of two values below m fits in a long). Recursively: power(a, n) = half² if n is even, half² · a if odd, where half = power(a, n/2) — compute half once.

The result must be in [0, m); power(a, 0, m) = 1 % m.

⏱ Complexity check. One case runs your code on a large input (n = 10¹⁸ (200,000 calls)) inside a 3-second limit. An O(log n) solution finishes in a fraction of a second on any ordinary laptop; an O(n) (multiplying n times) or calling power(a, n/2) twice one needs far longer and the case prints TOO SLOW. Two recursive calls per level make the work O(n) again. The limit is generous on purpose — if it fails, the algorithm is the problem, not your machine.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • O(log n) multiplications, recursion depth O(log n).
  • Reduce a modulo m first; never let a product exceed (m−1)².

Kết quả phải nằm trong [0, m); power(a, 0, m) = 1 % m.

Hai lời gọi đệ quy mỗi tầng lại làm công việc thành O(n). Hạn đặt rộng có chủ ý — trượt ca này thì do thuật toán, không phải do máy bạn.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: n is halved at every call, so there are ⌊log₂ n⌋ + 1 calls (about 60 for n = 10¹⁸), each with at most two multiplications: T(n) = T(n/2) + O(1) = O(log n). This is how RSA and Diffie–Hellman compute powers with 2048-bit exponents.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: n giảm một nửa mỗi lời gọi, nên có ⌊log₂ n⌋ + 1 lời gọi (khoảng 60 với n = 10¹⁸), mỗi lời gọi tối đa hai phép nhân: T(n) = T(n/2) + O(1) = O(log n). Đó là cách RSA và Diffie–Hellman tính luỹ thừa với số mũ 2048 bit.

mistakesJson.loi: return power(a, n/2, m) * power(a, n/2, m) % m — two calls per level: 2^(log n) = n calls, O(n) again.|||return power(a, n/2, m) * power(a, n/2, m) % m — hai lời gọi mỗi tầng: 2^(log n) = n lời gọi, lại O(n).
Multiplying by a without reducing it — a = 10¹⁸ times a value near 10⁹ overflows the long.|||Nhân với a mà không lấy mod — a = 10¹⁸ nhân giá trị gần 10⁹ là tràn long.
power(a, 0, 1) returning 1 — every value modulo 1 is 0.|||power(a, 0, 1) trả 1 — mọi giá trị modulo 1 đều là 0.
